svg.title: Install and verify
svg.desc: Solana Validator Failover v0.7.0. Load the pinned installer. It fetches the selected role’s wizard and daemon, plus the tag’s SHA256SUMS manifest. It checks both files and runs the wizard only if both hashes match. A missing file, manifest or entry, or a checksum mismatch, aborts installation. A fresh install defaults to DRY_RUN. Separately, use Git and the trusted SSH signer documented in SECURITY.md to verify the v0.7.0 tag before running the installer.
